output.summary: The rise in admitted-patient ED length of stay is almost entirely boarding (about 3.0 of 3.2 hours). Nurse staffing hours, vacancy and grid compliance are flat, and volume, acuity, beds and occupancy are unchanged, so the understaffing, volume and capacity hypotheses fail. The March rounding change delayed medical-ward discharges. Surgical wards, which were not changed, show no shift. The 4 West pilot ran on days set by a prior rotation and is a credible natural experiment, with halved boarding. Nurse strain is a downstream effect of boarding. The evening bed-cleaning cut is unproven. Extend the huddle. Do not fund travel nurses by cutting case managers, and do not pause the huddle.
